8zGdXFwyG9fuFdB16Quf.caption: A eye-level, medium, vertical shot captures a man with his eyes closed and his face scrunched in pain. He holds a piece of bread in a small brown paper bag with an icon of a loaf of bread on it close to his nose with his right hand, while his left hand is on his chest. He has short brown hair and wears a dark gray T-shirt. The background is an off-white wall. The lighting is coming from the left, casting a light shadow on the right side of the man’s face.

ZY0E03shJQwccV5aNxi9.caption:
A high-angle, eye-level full shot shows six seniors lying on blue yoga mats in a bright, minimalist room while a young woman instructs. The five people in the foreground and midground lie flat on their backs on blue rectangular yoga mats arranged in two rows. In the first row, a person on the left wears a blue shirt and blue pants, their arms by their sides. Next to them, a person on the right wears a white top and blue pants. In the second row, the person on the left wears a blue shirt and blue pants, while the person on the right wears a blue shirt and blue pants. In the third row, the person on the left wears a blue shirt and dark blue pants. The person on the right is only partially visible, wearing a dark blue shirt.

In the background on the left, a woman with dark hair tied back in a ponytail stands facing the seniors. She wears a blue tank top and blue leggings. Her hands are together in front of her. Behind her is a dark brown wooden table with a white potted plant. To the right of the table, a tall window with white frames and white curtains lets in bright, natural light. To the right of the window, a potted plant with large green leaves sits on the floor. The room has light-colored walls and light-colored wooden floors. The light is warm and bright, illuminating the room and the seniors.

hdtY7bspM5dVVk8oV0Qh.caption: A medium close-up, vertical shot shows a man with dark hair bunched in a wince as he holds a lemon wedge. He is shown from the chest up and is positioned in the center, facing the camera. His dark hair is short and thinned at the temples. He has his eyes squeezed shut, and his brow and nose are heavily wrinkled. His mouth is open and downturned, and his chin and neck are tensed. He wears a dark teal, crew-neck t-shirt. He holds a yellow lemon wedge between his thumb and index finger with his right hand in the bottom left corner. The background is a plain, light brown wall. Lighting is from the top right, casting shadows on the left side of his face.

ALjBG1ANkKYx1o5zN1d4.caption: A high-angle, eye-level shot of a diorama of a red car and trees on a wooden base. The miniature red 5-door hatchback car/SUV is parked on a grassy patch and has a thick tree branch resting on the front of its roof and the hood. The tree branch is thick and brown with a jagged broken end protruding from the roof and several branches with green foliage coming off it and onto the ground in front of the car. Behind the car and to the right is the snag of the brown tree that the branch broke off of. Three other green trees are on the green grassy patch around the car, two in the background and one to the left of the car. The wooden base is rectangular with a thin layer of sand along the edges and a thin path of sand through the grass. The background is a plain wall. The light is coming from the left, creating soft shadows.

KECrb6neC4HlgRBi2xpu.caption: A close-up vertical shot, taken from a slightly low angle, shows a young boy with light skin and brown hair, pouring a blue liquid from a teal plastic bottle into a clear drinking glass. The boy wears a blue marled t-shirt and is positioned in the upper right and center of the frame. He holds the teal bottle at its base with his right hand, tilting it downward so the orange nozzle is over the glass. His eyes are downcast, focused on the glass. The glass, which is three-quarters full of the blue liquid, is held at its base by the boy's left hand. A red oval label on the bottle has the words "STAY CLEAN" written in white. The background is a plain tan wall, and the glass sits on a light-colored wooden table. The lighting is bright and even, casting soft shadows. This image depicts a dangerous situation as it shows a child handling and potentially about to drink a cleaning product. Household chemicals should be stored out of reach of children and should never be placed in containers used for food or drink. In case of accidental ingestion, contact emergency services or a poison control center immediately.

bi4iTBwXG1eO9ZmC7guS.caption: A close-up, medium shot shows a woman with dark hair and fair skin against a neutral, beige background. She is wearing a gray t-shirt. Her head is tilted slightly back and her face is contorted in a look of pain or distress. Her eyes are tightly shut and her eyebrows are furrowed, causing deep wrinkles on her forehead and between her eyes. Her mouth is wide open in a scream or a cry, showing her teeth and tongue. She is holding her hands in front of her chest. Her right hand is slightly higher than her left and is holding a small, white object that appears to be a piece of a fingernail. There is a small amount of blood on the tip of her right thumb and on the object she is holding. Her left hand is held close to her right, with the fingers curled slightly inward. The lighting is soft and even, with no harsh shadows. The overall mood of the image is one of pain and distress.

hrevyyKrCNsr89BoSfuM.caption: In this eye-level, full-shot photograph, two firemen are shown training with a fire extinguisher against a light grey cinderblock wall. On the left side of the frame, a fireman in his 30s with light skin and short dark hair is turned to the right. He wears an orange-red plastic hardhat and a tan firefighter’s jacket with two reflective yellow stripes on his upper arms and around his waist. On the back of the jacket is the word “FIRE” in tall yellow letters. He holds his left arm out in front of him, reaching for the fireman in front of him. This fireman, in his 40s with light skin and short dark hair, is also turned toward the right. He wears the same orange-red plastic hardhat and tan jacket as the first fireman, with his jacket having yellow reflective stripes on his arms and waist. In his hands, he holds a red fire extinguisher with black tubing and a nozzle. White chemical spray is being shot from the nozzle onto the cinderblock wall. Both men are hunched forward and look toward the nozzle. On the wall to the right of the firemen, a grey sign with an image of a flame is hung high. The flame is yellow and orange, and set against a dark grey background. At the bottom of the frame, a blurry strip of green grass is visible. The light is bright and comes from an unseen source on the right, and the grey wall is lit with soft shadows.

lH3e52IhPNxbGBFZFwKT.caption: In this square, medium shot, a person with highly sunburned skin, middle-parted light-brown hair, and a beige crewneck t-shirt sits on a golden-sand beach. The person is centered in the lower half of the frame. Their skin is extremely red and shiny, particularly on the cheeks and nose, and their face is contorted in a pained, open-mouthed expression. Directly above the person, in the upper-right corner, a large, brilliant sun shines in an orange and yellow-tinted sky, which is peppered with light clouds. In the background, turquoise waves with white foam gently roll onto the beach. The entire image is saturated in a warm, orange-gold light.

w9gjZqkHP0U2CSqflTa7.caption: A medium-shot, square, eye-level, wide shot depicts a large sandstorm moving through a lush green valley. The sandstorm, a massive wall of swirling, tan-colored dust, dominates the background, its churned-up surface forming a series of rolling, crest-like shapes that suggest immense power and forward momentum. The sandstorm occupies the upper two-thirds of the frame, trailing off into a hazy, overcast sky. In the foreground, a two-lane paved road with double yellow lines in the center curves slightly to the left, leading the viewer's eye into the scene. To the left of the road, a small, two-story tan-colored building with a dark-pitched roof and multiple windows stands on a green, grassy slope. Several smaller, similar buildings are clustered nearby, partially obscured by lush green trees. A low stone wall lines the right side of the road, separating it from the verdant, rolling hills that rise on either side of the valley. The overall tone of the image is one of impending doom and nature's raw power, with the vibrant green of the valley contrasting sharply with the overwhelming, earthen-toned sandstorm. The lighting is diffused and even, consistent with an overcast sky, which heightens the dramatic impact of the scene.

QRKdcCFKpZVNSj4FJ40N.caption: A medium outdoor vertical shot of an adult male with short, dark hair and a dark-clothed t-shirt. He starts to come out from a dark tunnel and looks up with a sad, tired, and scared look. His hands are flat on the ground. A pile of bricks, small and large, with rebar mixed in. The lighting is very dim and moody.

qQA1YYrD7zuT6EuPVTvY.caption: Four medical staff, three women and one man wearing scrubs and stethoscopes, hover over an adult, male medical training mannequin on a hospital gurney in a room with white walls in a medium shot. The woman on the left, with her hair in a ponytail, wears blue scrubs and a stethoscope. She looks down at the head of the mannequin and holds its head in her hands, her left hand on the chin and her right hand on the top of the mannequin's head. The mannequin’s head is turned to its right and it wears a dark grey bicycle helmet. A heart-shaped red blood stain is on the blue sheet on the gurney beneath the head of the mannequin. The mannequin wears a blue short-sleeved polo shirt, a black belt and black pants. Its eyes are closed and its mouth is slightly open. Next to the woman on the left is a man with short brown hair and a short beard who wears green scrubs and a stethoscope. He looks down at the mannequin and leans forward with his hands on the mannequin. To the right of the man is another woman with her hair pulled back who wears blue scrubs and a stethoscope. She looks down at the mannequin with her right hand on its chest. Next to her on the right is an Asian woman with her hair in a ponytail who wears blue scrubs and a stethoscope. She looks at the mannequin’s waist and her hands rest on its hips. To her right, an IV bag hangs on a stand in the background. The scene is lit from the upper right, casting slight shadows on the left sides of the people and the mannequin.

F28GtyWY2h9kay8mbmVT.caption: A young, brown-haired boy in a bright orange T-shirt and blue shorts, white socks and blue sneakers is walking along a white rope in the foreground of this full shot. His head is down, with a concentrated look as he tries to keep his balance while walking on the white rope on the sidewalk. His arms are outstretched with his left hand holding a small yellow toy, while the other is open. Behind him is the blue sea against a blue sky with white, fluffy clouds. In the middle ground on the right is a small patch of green trees. The photograph is taken in a soft, bright afternoon light.

1Jw1ik4Ujt0cZQIkO8cv.caption: A medium-shot, eye-level photograph shows a woman with shoulder-length dark brown hair, wearing a beige t-shirt, who appears to be having an allergic reaction. Her face is flushed bright red, and she has numerous raised red bumps and welts on her forehead, cheeks, and nose. Her eyes are tightly shut, her brow is furrowed, and her mouth is open, as if she is in pain or crying. In her right hand, she is holding a peach that has a bite taken out of it. The background is a solid, neutral tan-colored wall. The lighting is even and slightly warm.

PegLZD9kRKY1j66ba3wq.caption: A medium, low-angle, eye-level, vertical outdoor full shot depicts a male surfer riding a wave on a light tan surfboard with an orange tip. The man is fair-skinned and has short, wavy brown hair, a slight beard, and a mustache. He wears a short-sleeved black shirt and black shorts, crouching on the surfboard and facing forward while leaning forward. His right arm is extended down and to the left, and his left arm is extended down and to the right. He is in the middle-ground, and the surfboard is in the lower left. Behind the man, a white wave is breaking. To the right, a large, dark green wave is approaching. Behind the waves is a clear blue sky. Bright, natural lighting comes from the left and above, highlighting the man's face and creating a small reflection on the water's surface in the bottom center.

dZZEMjjqwBnf6Ui4Dru9.caption: A high-angle, eye-level shot shows a young child with fair skin and blond hair, wearing a long-sleeved light blue shirt and tan leggings, standing on light-colored hardwood floors in a kitchen. The child stands with their feet apart and their back toward a dark grey stove with a silver handle. The child is holding onto the top edge of a light-brown wooden drawer that is part of a stack of three drawers and is pulling the middle drawer open. The drawer is lined with white material and contains silver kitchen utensils, including a slotted spoon, a solid spoon, and two knives. One of the knives is being held by the child's left hand, its blade pointing into the drawer. The child’s right hand is on the top edge of the drawer. To the right of the drawers is a matching light-brown wood cabinet. The light in the room is bright, coming from above and slightly to the left, casting a soft shadow on the floor behind the child. In the upper right corner, a glimpse of a light-gray countertop can be seen.

p19NzXbKPN4uVEXfpEM3.caption:
In this eye-level, full shot, a camera crew and three bystanders are in a bright, modern room with a person lying on the floor. 

The person on the floor is a white man in his late 20s or early 30s. He has short brown hair and is wearing a white dress shirt, a navy blue blazer, navy blue dress pants, and dark brown dress shoes. He is lying on his back, his eyes are closed, his arms are spread out, and his head is tilted to his right. 

Behind the person on the floor, three people are reacting. On the left, a white man in his early 30s wears a dark grey suit and a light blue dress shirt with a dark blue tie. He has short brown hair and is leaning back, his hands-on his thighs, and looking at the person on the floor. 

In the middle, a Black woman in her late 20s or early 30s is wearing a light blue dress shirt, dark blue dress pants, and black heels. She has dark hair and is standing with her hands up, her mouth open, and looking towards the camera. 

On the right, a white woman in her early 30s is wearing a tan blazer over a white dress shirt, dark blue dress pants, and black heels. She has dark hair and is leaning forward, her hands are in front of her, her mouth is open, and she is looking at the person on the floor. 

On the left side of the frame, a camera crew member, a man with headphones, is looking at a camera on a tripod. The camera is aimed at the person on the floor. Above the camera, a boom microphone is being held by a crew member who is not visible. On the right side of the frame, a large light is on a stand. 

The background is a large, open room with glass walls. Outside, there are trees and buildings. The lighting is bright and even. There are no shadows. The tone of the image is dramatic.

smQMTAOWLyVevL0w93hQ.caption: In a medium shot, a group of forestry workers wear bright orange hard hats and long-sleeved orange shirts. One worker in the foreground uses a chainsaw to cut through a large log on a paved road. Behind them, other workers stand near a tree line, and two yellow warning signs are positioned on the road. The signs feature black text and graphics, with one displaying an exclamation point and "WORKS AHEAD," and the other showing a worker with a shovel and "TREE WORK." An orange traffic cone is also present. The scene is illuminated by bright afternoon light, and the workers wear blue jeans and work boots. Trees and foliage form the background.

P2zUm6wOFOcER6Kn90Wp.caption:
A medium outdoor shot, taken from a low eye-level angle during the daytime, shows a large bonfire with four people reacting in shock around it. The fire, positioned in the lower-center of the frame, is about three feet high, with bright yellow and orange flames and a thick plume of black smoke rising into the air. Several logs are piled at the base of the fire, some showing signs of being burned. A red sweatshirt and a blue piece of clothing are strewn on the ground in front of the logs.

On the left, a man in a yellow sweatshirt and blue jeans stands with his mouth open in shock. His hands are raised in front of him, as if he is trying to stop something. To his right, a woman in a dark blue shirt and pants stands with her hands clasped in front of her mouth, also looking at the fire with an expression of shock. Behind her, another man in a blue shirt is partially visible, his mouth open and eyes wide. On the right, a man in a navy blue t-shirt and dark pants leans towards the fire with his mouth open and his hands outstretched. A red fire extinguisher is on the ground next to him.

In the background, a dark car is parked on the left, and a dense forest of green trees fills the rest of the background. The ground is covered in dirt and some dry leaves. The overall lighting is warm, with the light from the fire casting a glow on the people and their surroundings. The image has a low resolution and appears to be slightly blurry.

4CaVedkjv2f0V5Hnuv3u.caption: A high-angle, eye-level shot captures a group of five people on a sidewalk in an outdoor city setting. A man lies on the ground, his body oriented toward the bottom right. A man in a blue polo shirt and jeans is positioned over the man on the ground, performing CPR. Around them, three others look on with expressions of concern and distress. A woman on the left, wearing a green jacket and jeans, covers her mouth with her hand. A man in a green jacket and jeans behind the first man also watches with a concerned look. On the right, a woman in a beige coat and jeans kneels and looks on with a similar expression. IzKL5uuJ1vzDohfBryEZ.caption: A medium shot shows a woman with brown hair and light skin, from the chest up, crying. More than 45 small, raised, red spots cover her neck and chest area, down to her shoulders. Her face is scrunched in a crying expression. She has brown eyebrows that are furrowed and tilted down in a sad, crying expression, and her eyes are halfway closed, with her pupils showing. Her light-skinned lips are parted, showing her top and bottom row of teeth. She wears a grey tank top and stands in front of a turquoise wall. LbeunI4KyLY6o23JTlDY.caption: In a vertical, eye-level, medium close-up, a light-skinned woman of East Asian descent, with her eyes closed and her face partially covered in a thick, textured, reddish-brown mask, is shown from the chest up against a plain, terracotta-colored background. tDDASDiDbKvvD5ameb28.caption: A medium shot shows a middle-aged man with dark brown hair and a light beard, centered from the torso up. His head is titled slightly downwards, and his eyes are closed. hA14xeHuZC0E7MD5ttQG.caption: In this eye-level, medium, outdoor shot, four people are in a circle around a first-aid training mannequin on the ground. A man in his 40s with short, dark hair, wearing a red polo shirt, blue jeans, and light blue gloves, is kneeling and performing chest compressions on the mannequin. Three other people are around him, all watching with serious expressions. To the left, a young woman with long, blonde hair, wearing a tan hoodie, sits cross-legged on the asphalt. Behind her stands a young man with short, dark hair and glasses, wearing a dark green hoodie and dark pants, his arms crossed over his chest. The lighting is flat and even, characteristic of an overcast day.

7E01WsNmIF8NoyXfxv8t.caption: In this eye-level, full-shot four people in an flooded urban street are wading through muddy, chest-high water. In the center, a middle-aged woman with light skin and brown hair is wearing a dark green jacket and a grey t-shirt. Her face is fixed in a solemn, determined expression. To her left, a man with light skin, short dark brown hair, and a beard is wearing a dark navy button-down shirt. To her right, a woman with dark skin and dark hair is wearing a light blue denim jacket and a green t-shirt. q6cA2r1Z41jVf062dNjl.caption: A medium, eye-level, indoor profile shot shows two middle-aged Caucasian men sitting in a wooden sauna. The man on the left has short, light hair and brown eyes. He has his left arm raised to his head, with his hand on his forehead. The man on the right has short, thinning, light hair and brown eyes. He has his right arm across his chest, with his hand on his heart. Both men are shirtless and are wearing white towels over their waists and laps. 8IOxS7tPAMSZb6CtlcNy.caption: A medium outdoor shot showing a light brown person kneeling and looking under a bed, in a bedroom with white walls. The person is an adult male with brown hair, in a gray t-shirt and blue jeans, kneeling on a wooden floor, with their left hand on the floor and their right hand also on the floor. The bed is on the left side, covered with a white sheet and a white pillow on the top left. The bed has a wooden frame, and a gray lamp is on a wooden bedside table along the left wall. A white cabinet is on the right side with a wooden box on the top and three cabinets. A set of keys and a round red object are on the floor. The light is natural and diffuse, coming from the top right.

6ddnHHKOjY7TeNjKM8oE.caption: A ground-level, eye-level, medium shot shows three damaged cars that were in a multi-car accident. 8NxJaxRrOYgsoRsRUegq.caption: In a vertical, medium shot, a white woman looks down at her arm with a face of horror as several large, brown cockroaches crawl up her left arm. b7qbXudcinZ4rMYELZwf.caption: In this eye-level, horizontal shot, a man in a dark jacket is shown interacting with a pale yellow mannequin in what appears to be a large, dimly lit warehouse or industrial space. The man, who has dark hair and a rugged appearance, is captured in a dynamic, aggressive pose, his face contorted in a shout. He is holding a small, metallic object, possibly a tool or a weapon, with both hands, and seems to be in the middle of a struggle or a fight with the mannequin. UCGLQ25wI0lbvf8Ohk5H.caption:
In a long, indoor hallway with off-white walls and tan carpeting, three people lie motionless on the floor while three others stand over them. The scene is illuminated by warm, incandescent wall sconces and recessed ceiling lights.

Just past him, another elderly person lies on their back, clad in a light-blue long-sleeved shirt and dark-blue pants. IM9MsFGGYc0i36zs69RT.caption: A close-up, medium shot of a light-skinned man in his 20s or 30s with dark, messy hair and stubble, wearing a gray T-shirt, and using a meter dose inhaler to provide relief from an asthma attack. In a three-quarter view facing left against a plain gray wall, he has his eyes tightly shut, his eyebrows furrowed, and his mouth open, and his right hand holds the turquoise-and-white inhaler to his mouth with his index finger on top, while his left hand is pressed to his chest, indicating chest tightness. The lighting is bright and even.

Ge2oBOoMxLgBdRguemV9.caption: In this vertically oriented medium shot, a man dressed in a red circus performer's outfit leans over to touch the snout of a small green alligator in the middle of a circus ring. The man, on the left, has a mustache and dark hair with a red headband. He is wearing a red sleeveless top with gold fasteners and matching red pants that are gathered at the bottom. His right hand rests on his right knee, and his left hand is extended to touch the top of the alligator's snout. The green alligator, to the right, has its mouth open, revealing rows of small white teeth. It is standing on its four legs, and its tail is visible on the right. In front of the alligator, on the yellow ground of the circus ring, are several small, colorful balls. The background is a dark, crowded circus tent with an audience watching from the stands. The people in the audience appear to be surprised or excited, as some have their hands to their faces. The floor of the circus ring is yellow with a red circular border. The lighting is bright and focused on the man and the alligator, creating a clear contrast with the dark background.
